name: Rye and Corn Bread
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one quart of rye meal or rye flour
ingredients.originalText: one quart of rye meal or rye flour
ingredients.quantityText: one quart of rye meal or rye flour

instructions.text: place Indian meal in a pan and pour over it just enough boiling water to merely wet it, stirring constantly with a spoon
add rye meal or rye flour, molasses, and salt
make it as stiff as can be stirred with a spoon, mixing with warm water
in the morning add a level teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water
put it in a large pan and smooth the top with the hand dipped in cold water
let it stand a short time
bake five or six hours, or if put in the oven late in the day, let it remain all night

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. place Indian meal in a pan and pour over it just enough boiling water to merely wet it, stirring constantly with a spoon
2. add rye meal or rye flour, molasses, and salt
3. make it as stiff as can be stirred with a spoon, mixing with warm water
4. let rise all night
5. in the morning add a level teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little water
6. put it in a large pan and smooth the top with the hand dipped in cold water
7. let it stand a short time
8. bake five or six hours, or if put in the oven late in the day, let it remain all night
